Mrs. Harrington started with 12 boxes and gave away 2 boxes to her mom and 2 boxes to her sister (4 boxes in total).
Boxes remaining = 12 - 4 = 8 boxes.

Since each box contains 20 oranges:
Total oranges remaining = 8 × 20 = 160 oranges.

She kept 1/4 of the oranges and sold the rest (3/4 of the oranges):
Oranges sold = 160 × (3/4) = 120 oranges.

ANSWER: 120
